system.description: Essence Training Package Spell List 14.1.6 - Hearth Magic. Spells to prepare, preserve, dehydrate, and cook food and drink, control temperature and water, forage, and detect poison.
Gives caster a +20 to all Cooking maneuvers and +10 to anyone to whom he describes the preparation. May also be used to chill or warm a food to the proper serving temperature.
Causes a 2" flame to spring from the caster's finger. This flame will ignite any flammable material just as a normal fire would.
This spell perfectly prepares one day's worth of food (1 ration) for one week. Also instantly freshens any slightly turned or spoiled food (e.g., wilted lettuce).

This spell removes most of the water from one day's worth of food, reducing the weight of the food by 80%-90%. The food will be edible only after water has been added to it (approximately 2 quarts per ration). As long as the food is dry, the food remains dehydrated and the normal spoilage rate is decreased by 10 times.
Caster condenses 1 cubic foot of water from the surrounding air.

This spell neutralizes abnormal diseases, poisons, and other similar substances in one day's worth (1 ration) of food and/or water. It will not neutralize a poison or similar substance that is a natural part of the food. Special magical poisons/diseases might be allowed a RR (GM's discretion). When the duration ends, any poisons or diseases in food consumed during the duration return to normal potency. Any food consumed during the duration remains purified permanently.
Allows caster to heat any desired container to any desired temperature (up to 500 degrees). This spell will also allow caster to cook food in the desired method (e.g. bake, fry, steam, braise, etc.).
Caster creates a smell and taste illusion that alters the flavor of food within any desired container to any reasonable taste, simulating the effects of spices or seasonings upon the food.
Allows caster to chill any desired container to any desired temperature (down to -40 degrees).

Creates a table, chairs, tablecloth and up to 12 place settings, candles, and everything needed for a meal is provided except for food and drink. At the end of the duration, all created items vanish. If the created items are used in any manner other than for dining then they instantly vanish.
As Food Dehydration I, except 3 rations are prepared.
Automatically and successfully prepares one course, taking only half the normal preparation time. In addition to normal cooking, caster also detects any spoiled or poisoned food.
As Condensation I, except caster creates 3 cubic feet of water.
Allows caster to digest grass, wood, woody stems, etc. and receive nourishment from such for one day.
Allows caster to age food or drink by up to 20 years. This can be used to improve the flavor of certain foods or it can be used to rot the target food.
Caster may detect any poison. The caster may concentrate on a different 1'R each round.
As Sustenance Purification, except purifies up to 20 rations.
As Food Dehydration I, except preserves 5 rations.
As Condensation I, except produces 5 cubic feet of water.
As Cookery, except may prepare one course per level of the caster.
As Forage, except for duration.

As Create Setting, except caster creates everything necessary for one meal. Provides food and drink (any type), all serving and dining implements, table, chairs, lighting, linen, etc. The banquet can serve up to 20 people with up to 10 courses.
Caster may use any lower level spell on this list each round for the duration of this spell.
